title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Mango Guava Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Mango Guava Ice by Doozy Infinity is a tropical fruit blend with a bright, juicy character and a fresh, icy finish. Sweet Mango delivers a rich, nectar-like base, while Guava adds a fresher, tangier note that lifts the flavour with it mellow sweetness. A streak of cool Ice rounds it off, bringing some delightful refreshment to this perfect pairing of fresh fruit flavours. This Nic Salt e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, making it perfect for low-powered MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as pod kits and vape pens. The nicotine salt formula ensures quicker absorption and a more comfortable inhale than high-strength freebase options. Offered in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Doozy Infinity Nic Salts deliver imaginative flavour combinations that stay smooth and satisfying throughout.
